From 5c65b96b549ea2dcfde497436bf9e048deb87758 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yuqi Xu <xuyq21@lenovo.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 16:54:23 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] Bluetooth: hci_sync: reject oversized Broadcast Announcement
 prepend

Existing advertising instances can already hold the maximum extended
advertising payload. When hci_adv_bcast_annoucement() prepends the
Broadcast Announcement service data to that payload, the combined data
may no longer fit in the temporary buffer used to rebuild the
advertising data.

Reject that case before copying the existing payload and report the
failure through the device log. This keeps the existing advertising
data intact and avoids overrunning the temporary buffer.

Fixes: 5725bc608252 ("Bluetooth: hci_sync: Fix broadcast/PA when using an existing instance")
Cc: stable@kernel.org
Reported-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Zhengchuan Liang <zcliangcn@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Xin Liu <bird@lzu.edu.cn>
Assisted-by: Codex:GPT-5.4
Signed-off-by: Yuqi Xu <xuyq21@lenovo.com>
Signed-off-by: Ren Wei <n05ec@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Luiz Augusto von Dentz <luiz.von.dentz@intel.com>

diff --git a/net/bluetooth/hci_sync.c b/net/bluetooth/hci_sync.c
index aeccd8084cba..df23245d6ccd 100644
--- a/net/bluetooth/hci_sync.c
+++ b/net/bluetooth/hci_sync.c
@@ -1725,6 +1725,11 @@ static int hci_adv_bcast_annoucement(struct hci_dev *hdev, struct adv_info *adv)
 	/* Generate Broadcast ID */
 	get_random_bytes(bid, sizeof(bid));
 	len = eir_append_service_data(ad, 0, 0x1852, bid, sizeof(bid));
+	if (adv->adv_data_len > sizeof(ad) - len) {
+		bt_dev_err(hdev, "No room for Broadcast Announcement");
+		return -EINVAL;
+	}
+
 	memcpy(ad + len, adv->adv_data, adv->adv_data_len);
 	hci_set_adv_instance_data(hdev, adv->instance, len + adv->adv_data_len,
 				  ad, 0, NULL);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary

The patch modifies the function `hci_adv_bcast_annoucement()` in **net/bluetooth/hci_sync.c** to prevent a buffer overflow when prepending the Broadcast Announcement service data to an existing advertising instance.

### Modifications

- **File:** `net/bluetooth/hci_sync.c`  
  - Added a bounds check before copying the existing advertising data (`adv->adv_data`) into the temporary buffer `ad`.  
  - If the combined size of the newly appended Broadcast Announcement data (`len`) and the existing advertising data (`adv->adv_data_len`) exceeds the capacity of `ad`, the function now returns `-EINVAL` and logs a device error.  
  - This ensures the `memcpy(ad + len, adv->adv_data, adv->adv_data_len)` cannot overrun the buffer, keeping the existing advertising data intact.

### Relationships

- The new `if` statement directly protects the subsequent `memcpy` operation from causing a buffer overflow by validating that there is enough remaining space in `ad` after writing the Broadcast Announcement service data.  
- Without this check, an advertising instance already holding the maximum extended advertising payload would cause the combined data to exceed the temporary buffer size, leading to a memory corruption bug. The fix correctly rejects such oversized configurations and reports the failure via `bt_dev_err`.

Fixes: 5725bc608252 ("Bluetooth: hci_sync: Fix broadcast/PA when using an existing instance")

Here is the patch:
  */
 static int hci_adv_bcast_annoucement(struct hci_dev *hdev, struct adv_info *adv)
 {
 	u8 bid[3];
 	u8 ad[HCI_MAX_EXT_AD_LENGTH];
 	u8 len;
 
 	/* Skip if NULL adv as instance 0x00 is used for general purpose
 	 * advertising so it cannot used for the likes of Broadcast Announcement
 	 * as it can be overwritten at any point.
 	 */
 	if (!adv)
 		return 0;
 
 	/* Check if PA data doesn't contains a Basic Audio Announcement then
 	 * there is nothing to do.
 	 */
 	if (!eir_get_service_data(adv->per_adv_data, adv->per_adv_data_len,
 				  0x1851, NULL))
 		return 0;
 
 	/* Check if advertising data already has a Broadcast Announcement since
 	 * the process may want to control the Broadcast ID directly and in that
 	 * case the kernel shall no interfere.
 	 */
 	if (eir_get_service_data(adv->adv_data, adv->adv_data_len, 0x1852,
 				 NULL))
 		return 0;
 
 	/* Generate Broadcast ID */
 	get_random_bytes(bid, sizeof(bid));
 	len = eir_append_service_data(ad, 0, 0x1852, bid, sizeof(bid));
+	if (adv->adv_data_len > sizeof(ad) - len) {
+		bt_dev_err(hdev, "No room for Broadcast Announcement");
+		return -EINVAL;
+	}
+
 	memcpy(ad + len, adv->adv_data, adv->adv_data_len);
 	hci_set_adv_instance_data(hdev, adv->instance, len + adv->adv_data_len,
 				  ad, 0, NULL);
 
 	return hci_update_adv_data_sync(hdev, adv->instance);
 }
